title: Critical dimension as main term minus error
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $s$ be the greatest natural number at most $2^{w+2}$ satisfying $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\le 1/2$. Define the critical dimension as $ws$ and its error as $(\log 2)w2^w-ws$. Then the critical dimension equals $(\log 2)w2^w$ minus its error.
hypotheses_covered: The critical size is the greatest qualifying $s\le 2^{w+2}$
